title: santaloides luzoniensis
intro: Santaloides luzoniensis, commonly known as the Luzon sandalwood or Luzon yellow sandalwood, is a plant species that belongs to the genus Santaloides and family Santalaceae. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of Santaloides luzoniensis include its potential to aid in wound healing, reduce fever, and alleviate symptoms of respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, diterpenes, and triterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
